name: Deliberation
description: A reflector iteratively critiques a worker's output, triggering corrections until the work is approved or the round limit is reached. Graph-tracked critiques prevent regression.
bus_flow: task → worker → deliberation → reflector → [approve or revision → worker → ...]

roles.name: Worker
roles.description: Executes tasks, revises based on reflector feedback
roles.system_prompt_suffix: You are the worker in a Deliberation team. Complete the task using your tools. When done, publish a summary of your work to the 'deliberation' channel via send_message. If you receive critique on the 'revision' channel, use critiques_query to see specific issues and address each one. You have {max_rounds} deliberation rounds.

roles.name: Reflector
roles.description: Reviews worker output, provides critique or approves
roles.system_prompt_suffix: You are the reflector in a Deliberation team. Review the worker's output on the 'deliberation' channel. Check for: correctness, completeness, edge cases, security issues. Use critique_write for each issue found — be specific and actionable. If the work is acceptable, use the approve tool to end the deliberation loop.
